title: Four relaxed evening spots in Kampala
intro: Checked tonight, 9 Oct 2026. Every place below is a sit-down, talk-easy room rather than a loud club.

items.title: Cielo Lounge Rooftop
items.description: Fifth-floor open rooftop on The Cube. Skyline views, cocktails, light plates, DJ later on. Go just before sunset for a seat and the view. Relaxed early, fills up from about 10pm.
items.metadata: Open from 4pm. Cocktails 12,000-25,000. Beer 5,000-8,000. Budget 80,000-200,000 each. RSVP 0742 891 326.

items.title: Jazzville Bugolobi
items.description: Kampala's first jazz club. Live jazz and soul sets, low lighting, garden seating, a crowd that came to listen. The quietest of the four and the best one for actual conversation.
items.metadata: Open Mon-Sun, live sets usually midweek and Sunday. Cocktails about 10,000 and beer from 4,000 on old advertised nights, so treat as estimate. Entry usually free.

items.title: The Local, Bugolobi
items.description: Ugandan-inspired bar and kitchen, courtyard seating, cocktails and small plates made for grabbing a table and staying. The most casual of the four, and the easiest on the pocket.
items.metadata: Mon-Thu 9:00 AM to 11:00 PM, Fri-Sat to late, Sun 12:00 PM to 10:00 PM. Happy hour Mon-Thu 4:00 to 7:00 PM. 0776077093.

items.title: Emin Pasha Hotel garden and bar
items.description: Boutique colonial hotel behind landscaped gardens, so it is quiet in a way no rooftop is. The calm drink-and-talk choice, and the only one here you can walk to dinner after.
items.metadata: Grounds open daily, bar through the evening. Cocktails 12,000-25,000, beer 5,000-8,000, budget 80,000-150,000 each. Phone 031 2264712.

closing: Prices are the July 2026 Kampala guide figures and the venues' own listings, so treat the shilling numbers as close estimates, not quoted.
